keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Own Goal by Patrick Yazbek, Nashville SC. Nashville SC 0, FC Cincinnati 1.
Miles Robinson (FC Cincinnati) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
José Martínez (FC Cincinnati) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Patrick Yazbek (Nashville SC) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
First Half ends, Nashville SC 0, FC Cincinnati 1.
Substitution, Nashville SC. Bryan Acosta replaces Patrick Yazbek.
Second Half begins Nashville SC 0, FC Cincinnati 1.
Delay in match because of an injury Maxwell Woledzi (Nashville SC).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Nashville SC. Jack Maher replaces Maxwell Woledzi because of an injury.
Substitution, FC Cincinnati. Tyrell Malacia replaces Bryan Ramírez.
Substitution, FC Cincinnati. Pavel Bucha replaces José Martínez.
Substitution, FC Cincinnati. Tom Barlow replaces Evander.
Substitution, Nashville SC. Warren Madrigal replaces Matthew Corcoran.
Substitution, FC Cincinnati. Kenji Mboma Dem replaces Samuel Gidi.
Tyrell Malacia (FC Cincinnati) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
David Doudera (FC Cincinnati) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Nashville SC. Shak Mohammed replaces Cristian Espinoza.
Substitution, Nashville SC. Alex Muyl replaces Reed Baker-Whiting.
Substitution, FC Cincinnati. Ayoub Jabbari replaces David Doudera.
Ayoub Jabbari (FC Cincinnati) is shown the yellow card.
Second Half ends, Nashville SC 0, FC Cincinnati 1.
